name: movies
title: Movies — box office, ratings and genre (vega-datasets)
description: 3,201 films with production budget, US and worldwide gross, DVD sales, running time, distributor, director, genre and two critic scores. LICENCE: vega-datasets declares a per-resource licence for 58 of its 73 resources and movies is one of the 15 it does not, so no licence is asserted here either. The BSD-3-Clause on that repository covers its code and infrastructure, not the contents of the datasets it redistributes, and its own datapackage.json says so. Demo data: referenced by pinned URL and built locally. Meridian does not host, publish or redistribute this dataset.

licenses.name: notspecified
licenses.title: No licence declared at source for this resource

title.description: Film title. Nine of the 3,201 are bare JSON numbers rather than strings — 1776, 2012, 300 and their kind — which is why the source column arrives JSON-typed; vega-datasets documents this as a deliberate data-quality feature of the dataset.

release_date.description: US release date, parsed from the source's 'Jun 12 1998' strings. All 3,201 parsed at the time this Protocol was written.

mpaa_rating.description: MPAA certificate, as the source spells it.

major_genre.description: Single genre label assigned by the source.

creative_type.description: Source's commercial categorisation, e.g. Contemporary Fiction, Super Hero.

source_material.description: What the film was adapted from, if anything — the source's 'Source' column, renamed so it does not collide with the descriptor's own 'sources'.

director.description: Director, where the source records one.

production_budget.description: Production budget in nominal US dollars, not inflation-adjusted.

us_gross.description: US theatrical gross in nominal US dollars.

worldwide_gross.description: Worldwide theatrical gross in nominal US dollars.

us_dvd_sales.description: US DVD sales in nominal US dollars; absent for most rows.

imdb_rating.description: IMDB user rating out of 10, as captured by the source at collection time.

imdb_votes.description: Number of IMDB votes behind that rating.

rotten_tomatoes_rating.description: Rotten Tomatoes score out of 100, as captured by the source at collection time.
